revisions.text: I unconditionally condemned me, powerless in every sense of the word. But now, in death, I've become all that they fear and more.
I was a child when they unjustly condemned me, powerless in every sense of the word. But now, in death, I've become all that they feared and more.
I was a child when they unjustly condemned me, cowardice in every sense of the word. But now, in death, I've become all that they feared and more.
I was a child when they unjustly condemned me, cowards in every sense of the word. But now, in death, I've become all that they feared and more.
